sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This addendum extends SRS_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v1 with the eleven requirements added after owner decisions D16-D26 (2026-10-30): FR-27 (sole entry point + entry-time lock), FR-28 (Financial Goals rename + target fields), FR-29 (customizable share snapshot), FR-30 (global Privacy Mode), FR-31 (monthly grid auto-sort), FR-32 (charts trio, inline SVG), FR-33 (day-wise status sweep), FR-34 (in-app + email alerts), FR-35 (monthly history window), FR-36 (Add Position exact dates + credit day), FR-37 (monthly printable statement). Requirement ids match the PRD addendum prd_items exactly (hard FK to docs/PRD_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v2.json). No requirement of SRS v1 (FR-01..FR-24, NFR-1..NFR-13, DATA-01..DATA-05) or of addendum v1 (FR-25/FR-26) is altered by this document.

sections.heading: Day-wise interplay (with D5)
sections.body: FR-33 upgrades status timing from month-end to day-wise without touching the D5 Completed rule. Each position carries a credit day (1-28, per FR-36/D26). The daily sweep evaluates on the credit day: if that month's payment is unpaid, the position flips to Danger immediately that same day — not at month end. D5 Completed logic is unchanged: months paid >= tenure still forces Completed and overrides Danger, so a position that has paid its full tenure never flips to Danger regardless of credit-day timing. The day-wise flip also feeds FR-31 (Danger re-sorts to the top immediately) and FR-34 (before-due / day-of / overdue alert cadence is timed from the credit day).

sections.heading: Privacy scope
sections.body: Privacy Mode (FR-30) is a single global toggle: when ON, every monetary value renders as the mask '••••' on the dashboard, monthly grid, watch list, Financial Goals, share snapshots (FR-29) and the monthly print (FR-37); numbers, statuses and company names remain visible. The toggle state persists in local browser storage across reloads. Sharing (FR-29) and printing (FR-37) inherit the mask — neither surface may leak an amount while Privacy Mode is active. Non-monetary data (ISIN, dates, credit day, tenure, statuses) is never masked.

sections.heading: Data model deltas (documentation of deltas, not SQL)
sections.body: Wave-2 extends the established tables as follows. bonds: + start_date (exact date, replaces free-form start month for new adds), + end_date (exact date), + credit_day (integer, day-of-month 1-28); tenure becomes derived from start_date/end_date on new adds (legacy imports keep the imported tenure mapped per FR-36). financial_goals: + target_amount, + target_end_date; the goals surface is renamed Financial Goals (legacy irregular savings rows 39588/10063/0 import as goals). alert_prefs: new — per-position/global preference for before-due / day-of / overdue cadence, Gmail SMTP setup flag, channel set (in-app + email only). notifications: new — alert history rows (position ref, alert type, channel, timestamp, delivery status) retained in-app for audit. share_config: new — last-used per-section checkbox selections (totals, per-bond list, monthly history, amounts visibility) for the snapshot generator. These are documentation of intended deltas for downstream design/build; this document does not define SQL DDL.

requirements.text: When a user creates a position, the system SHALL accept it only through the Watch List add form (sole entry point); the active-position lock (FR-26) SHALL be evaluated at that submit, and if blocked the system SHALL write nothing and expose the position on no surface — the monthly grid SHALL provide payment entry and rendering only, with no alternate add route (D16).

acceptance_criteria.given: an active position 'Muthoottu' (On-going, ISIN IN1234567890) and a user attempting to add a duplicate '  MUTHOOTTU  ' (same name key) via the Watch List add form
acceptance_criteria.when: the form is submitted and the D15 lock blocks the add with a named error
acceptance_criteria.then: no bonds row is created and the monthly grid, dashboard and watch list show NO trace of the blocked position — the grid is unchanged (nothing entered the system)

acceptance_criteria.given: the app open on the monthly grid and on the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: the user looks for any 'add position' control on the grid or dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: no add-position control exists on either surface; the only add path is the Watch List add form

requirements.text: When the goals feature is rendered, the system SHALL label it 'Financial Goals' (renamed from 'Home Plan', tab label included) and each goal SHALL carry a target amount and a target end date so multi-year (e.g. 10-year) savings plans are first-class; legacy irregular savings rows (39588/10063/0) SHALL import as goals (D17).

acceptance_criteria.given: the app after the wave-2 rename
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the goals tab
acceptance_criteria.then: the tab label and page heading read 'Financial Goals' — the string 'Home Plan' appears nowhere in the goals UI

acceptance_criteria.given: the Financial Goals surface
acceptance_criteria.when: the user creates or edits a goal for a 10-year plan
acceptance_criteria.then: the form accepts a target amount and a target end date (e.g. end date 2036-10-30) and stores both on the goal row

acceptance_criteria.given: the legacy workbook's irregular savings rows (39588/10063/0)
acceptance_criteria.when: the legacy import runs
acceptance_criteria.then: each row appears as a goal in Financial Goals (imported values preserved), not as a bond position

requirements.text: When a user opens the Share panel, the system SHALL offer per-section checkboxes (totals, per-bond list, monthly history, amounts visibility) and generate an offline snapshot — a print-styled HTML file plus a CSV option — with no server and no accounts; the snapshot SHALL respect Privacy Mode by masking amounts when amounts are hidden (D18).

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio with positions and Privacy Mode OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: the user unchecks 'monthly history', leaves totals and per-bond list checked, and exports the HTML snapshot
acceptance_criteria.then: the generated HTML file contains the totals and per-bond list sections and contains NO monthly-history section, and the export requires no network access

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode ON
acceptance_criteria.when: the user exports both the HTML snapshot and the CSV option
acceptance_criteria.then: monetary values in both artifacts render as '••••' (or the CSV's masked equivalent) — no raw amount is present in either file

acceptance_criteria.given: the Share panel with per-section checkboxes
acceptance_criteria.when: the user toggles the 'amounts visibility' checkbox
acceptance_criteria.then: the snapshot preview updates to include or exclude amounts accordingly, without any server round-trip

requirements.text: When Privacy Mode is active, the system SHALL mask every monetary value as '••••' across the dashboard, monthly grid, watch list, Financial Goals, share snapshots and the monthly print, while leaving numbers, statuses and names visible; the header eye-icon toggle SHALL persist its state in local browser storage so the preference survives a reload (D19).

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode toggled ON via the header eye icon
acceptance_criteria.when: the user views the dashboard, monthly grid, watch list and Financial Goals
acceptance_criteria.then: every monetary value (invested amount, received amount, balance, goal target amount) renders as the mask '••••', while company names, ISINs, statuses and month/tenure numbers remain visible

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode toggled ON
acceptance_criteria.when: the user reloads the browser page
acceptance_criteria.then: Privacy Mode is still ON (state restored from local browser storage) and amounts are still masked as '••••'

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode toggled OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: the user views the same surfaces
acceptance_criteria.then: all monetary values render as their real numbers again — no residual '••••' masks remain

requirements.text: When the monthly grid renders, the system SHALL order rows Danger first, then On-going, then Completed last, and SHALL recompute the order automatically whenever any position's status changes, sinking a newly Completed position to the bottom without user action (D20).

acceptance_criteria.given: three positions — Alpha (On-going), Beta (Danger), Gamma (Completed) — displayed in the monthly grid
acceptance_criteria.when: the grid renders
acceptance_criteria.then: row order is exactly Beta (Danger), Alpha (On-going), Gamma (Completed)

acceptance_criteria.given: grid order Danger -> On-going -> Completed with Alpha still On-going in the middle
acceptance_criteria.when: Alpha's status flips to Completed (months paid >= tenure)
acceptance_criteria.then: the grid re-sorts automatically to Beta (Danger), Gamma (Completed), Alpha (Completed) — Alpha sinks below every Danger/On-going row with no user sort action

acceptance_criteria.given: an all-On-going grid
acceptance_criteria.when: one position flips to Danger by the day-wise sweep (FR-33)
acceptance_criteria.then: that position immediately becomes the top row — Danger always precedes On-going and Completed

requirements.text: When the dashboard renders, the system SHALL display a charts row containing (1) grouped bars of invested vs received per bond, (2) a cumulative returns line that turns red when the overall balance is negative, and (3) a status donut of the Danger/On-going/Completed split; all three charts SHALL render as inline SVG generated locally with no external chart CDN and no network requests (D21).

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio with at least two positions
acceptance_criteria.when: the dashboard loads
acceptance_criteria.then: three charts are present: grouped bars (invested vs received per bond), a cumulative returns line, and a status donut — each produced as inline SVG markup in the served page

acceptance_criteria.given: the dashboard page loaded with the browser network monitor open
acceptance_criteria.when: the charts row renders
acceptance_criteria.then: ZERO network requests go to any chart CDN or third-party host — the app remains fully offline (no cdn.jsdelivr, no charts.googleapis, no external script src for charting)

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio whose cumulative balance has gone negative (received < invested overall)
acceptance_criteria.when: the cumulative returns line chart renders
acceptance_criteria.then: the line segment for the negative-balance portion is drawn in red

requirements.text: When the daily sweep runs, the system SHALL evaluate each position's payment on its credit day (day-of-month 1-28) and SHALL flip the position to Danger on that same day if the month's payment is still unpaid — not at month-end; the D5 Completed logic (months paid >= tenure, Completed overriding Danger) SHALL remain unchanged (D22).

acceptance_criteria.given: a position with credit_day = 5 and an On-going status in the current month
acceptance_criteria.when: the day-wise sweep runs on day 6 of the month and the month's payment is still unpaid
acceptance_criteria.then: the position's status becomes Danger on day 6 itself (same day as the sweep), not at month-end

acceptance_criteria.given: the same position with credit_day = 5 whose payment WAS credited on day 5
acceptance_criteria.when: the day-wise sweep runs on days 6 through month-end
acceptance_criteria.then: the position stays On-going — no Danger flip for a paid month

acceptance_criteria.given: a position that has paid months >= tenure (D5 Completed condition)
acceptance_criteria.when: the day-wise sweep runs on and after its credit day with no further payment due
acceptance_criteria.then: the position remains Completed — the D5 Completed logic is unchanged and overrides any day-wise Danger evaluation

requirements.text: When an alert condition fires (before-due, day-of, or overdue on a position's credit day), the system SHALL deliver the alert through exactly the two shipped channels — the in-app notification bell and email via the owner's Gmail SMTP with an App Password (personal-to-personal, one-time setup) — SHALL retain the alert in the in-app history with a timestamp, and SHALL NOT ship SMS, WhatsApp, or web/mobile push (D24; cadence per D22).

acceptance_criteria.given: a position with credit_day = 5 and the alert cadence configured for before-due / day-of / overdue
acceptance_criteria.when: the sweep reaches day 3 (before-due), day 5 (day-of), then day 8 with payment still unpaid (overdue)
acceptance_criteria.then: each event produces BOTH an in-app bell notification AND an email through the owner's Gmail SMTP (App Password), and each appears in the in-app alert history list with its timestamp

acceptance_criteria.given: the alert system after several triggered alerts
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the alert history
acceptance_criteria.then: all past alerts are listed with timestamps and channel/delivery info (auditable history is retained, not cleared)

acceptance_criteria.given: the shipped application build
acceptance_criteria.when: the user inspects the alert channels
acceptance_criteria.then: only in-app bell and email exist — there is NO SMS, NO WhatsApp and NO push-notification channel or setting shipped

requirements.text: When the Monthly History table renders, the system SHALL show only elapsed months up to and including the current month, SHALL never render any future month column, and SHALL auto-append the current month's column from the ledger as each new month begins (D23).

acceptance_criteria.given: today is October 2026 and positions started September 2025
acceptance_criteria.when: the Monthly History table renders
acceptance_criteria.then: columns run from Sep 2025 through Oct 2026 (current month included) and NO column for Nov 2026 or any later month exists

acceptance_criteria.given: the history table showing through the current month Oct 2026
acceptance_criteria.when: the calendar advances to Nov 2026 and the table is viewed again
acceptance_criteria.then: a Nov 2026 column has auto-appended (from the ledger, no stored header row) as the new current month, and months after Nov 2026 are still never rendered

acceptance_criteria.given: the legacy Excel pattern that displayed futuristic year columns
acceptance_criteria.when: the new Monthly History is compared against it
acceptance_criteria.then: the new table contains zero future columns — only elapsed months + current month

requirements.text: When a user adds a position, the Add Position form SHALL accept an exact start date and end date via date pickers, SHALL auto-calculate tenure months from that range with no manual tenure field, and SHALL accept a payment credit day validated to the range 1-28 and stored on the position; legacy import SHALL map start_month to a start date, tenure to a computed end date, and default the credit day to the start date's day (D26).

acceptance_criteria.given: the Add Position form with start date 2025-09-03 and end date 2026-12-02 entered via date pickers
acceptance_criteria.when: the form computes tenure
acceptance_criteria.then: tenure auto-calculates to 15 months from the date range, with no manual tenure entry available

acceptance_criteria.given: the Add Position form's payment credit day field
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters 0, 29, 30, 31 or a non-integer
acceptance_criteria.then: the submit is rejected with a validation error — only values 1-28 are accepted

acceptance_criteria.given: a legacy row with start_month = '2025-09' and tenure = 15
acceptance_criteria.when: the legacy import runs
acceptance_criteria.then: the imported position gets a start date derived from that start month, an end date computed from tenure, and credit_day defaulted to the start date's day

requirements.text: When the user requests a monthly printable statement, the system SHALL render a dedicated A4 print-optimized HTML 'Monthly Print' view containing the month header, portfolio summary, this-month payment table, status list and alerts footer, and SHALL mask monetary values as '••••' when Privacy Mode is active (D25).

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio in a given month
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the Monthly Print view and prints (or previews print) on A4
acceptance_criteria.then: the view shows exactly the five sections — month header, portfolio summary, this-month payment table, status list, alerts footer — laid out to fit an A4 page

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode ON
acceptance_criteria.when: the Monthly Print view renders
acceptance_criteria.then: every monetary value in the summary, payment table and footer is masked as '••••' — the printed sheet shows no real amounts

acceptance_criteria.given: Privacy Mode OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: the Monthly Print view renders
acceptance_criteria.then: real monetary values appear and statuses/names/dates are complete for the printed statement
